definitions.explanation: Sheets of paper dyed in various colors, used for origami, school crafts, and decoration. Typically sold in square sheets in packs of mixed colors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色紙|いろがみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}った→折る：01263_oru⟧。
examples.english: The child folded a crane out of colored paper.

examples.japanese: {色紙|いろがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To cut colored paper and make decorations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{色紙|いろがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At kindergarten the children do colored-paper crafts every week.

notes:
The same kanji {色紙|いろがみ} can also be read しきし, which refers to a stiff square board used for autographs and calligraphy — a completely different object. Context and reading distinguish them.
